meta.portco: Bully Pulpit International (HQ 1445 New York Ave NW, Washington DC)
meta.description: Property sales (homes plus commercial/land) recorded in the District of Columbia since 2025-01-01, the county-equivalent BPI is headquartered in and draws most of its talent from.
meta.method: DC Office of Tax and Revenue real-property records via DC GIS 'Owner Polygons (Common Ownership Layer)' (MapServer layer 40), queried with where SALEDATE >= DATE '2025-01-01', paged 2,000 at a time (resultOffset), outSR 4326. lat/lon = mean of the parcel polygon's outer-ring vertices. use_type from PROPTYPE (Residential-* = residential). arms_length = ACCEPTCODE 'Market'. Owner names were deliberately NOT retained (buyer/seller null).
caveats: Assessor layer, not deeds: each parcel carries only its LAST sale, so a parcel that sold twice in the window appears once.
Condominium units are only partly represented in the owner-polygon layer (units share a footprint); DC condo sale counts are understated versus MRIS/Bright MLS.
Recent months lag: OTR posts recordations with a delay of several weeks, so the latest 1-2 months are incomplete.

Non-market transfers (ACCEPTCODE other than Market: e.g. Unusual, Speculative, Foreclosure, Buyer=Seller, Multi-lot) are kept but flagged arms_length=false; use arms-length residential rows for price statistics.
meta.relevance_to_portco: BPI is a people business: DC housing costs drive compensation pressure and hybrid-office strategy for its largest office; high-end DC neighborhood turnover also tracks the policy/lobbying professional class that forms BPI clients and recruits.

failed_sources.note: Not used: carries SSL/sale fields but no address or geometry; owner-polygon layer has both.
